commit.subject: LU-17000 utils: Fix resource leak in snapshot_load_conf_one
commit.message:
LU-17000 utils: Fix resource leak in snapshot_load_conf_one

This patch fixes memory leak. Foreign host(fhost) when
used as placeholder '-' and this is marked as NULL
it leaves memory dangling.

CoverityID: 504153 ("Resource leak")
Fixes: 815ca64afc8 ("LU-16072 utils: snapshot support to foreign host")
Signed-off-by: Arshad Hussain <arshad.hussain@aeoncomputing.com>
Change-Id: I093ba3ec21ff80a19e0bbffc55430daf8ab05c93
